llm.title: Untrusted executable path
llm.explanation: The subprocess runs "gzip" without an absolute path, so a malicious executable earlier in the PATH could be executed, leading to code execution if an attacker can influence the environment.
llm.suggestion: Use the full path to gzip (e.g., /usr/bin/gzip) or validate the executable before running.

llm+verify.verdict_reason: Running "gzip" via PATH allows a malicious executable to be invoked if the environment is compromised

llm.title: Assumes rows is a sized sequence
llm.explanation: If callers pass a generator or other iterator instead of a list, len(rows) raises TypeError, causing the importer to crash when processing rows.
llm.suggestion: Iterate over rows once, counting kept and skipped items (e.g., using a loop) or convert rows to a list after checking its type.

llm.title: Silent None return may cause downstream crashes
llm.explanation: When the API returns no results, the function returns None instead of raising or returning a consistent dict. Callers expecting a dict may later dereference None, causing TypeError at runtime.
llm.suggestion: Raise a specific exception for empty results or clearly document that callers must handle None
